purpose: What the model is ASKED when transcribing values from already-located quotes, one call for the group. The load-bearing check is that each value appears in that reading's own quote.
boundary: The RENDERED transcribe prompt. Comments and helper names are outside the boundary.
governance: A rendered prompt that changes is a NEW PROMPT VERSION. Do not edit this file to make an edited prompt pass. Do not add this file to the frozen PINNED set unless docs/acceptance/gate_versions.md is updated in the same change.

cases.why: the ordinary transcribe of a single located quote

inputs.passages:
[0] A BMI
"""
Arm A BMI was 22.1 kg/m2.
"""

cases.why: sibling quotes in one call — the shape the own-quote check exists for

inputs.passages:
[0] A BMI
"""
Arm A BMI was 22.1 kg/m2.
"""

[1] A age
"""
Arm A age was 31 +/- 8 years.
"""
